title: Sindh Public Private Partnership Amendment Act 2011

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Public Private Partnership Amendment Act 2011
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IX OF 2011
ACT IX OF 2011
SINDH PUBLIC PRIVATE PARTNERSHIP
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act to amend the Sindh
Public Private
Partnership Act, 2010
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV,
9th April, 2011]
No.PAS/Legis-B-06/2011, dated 9-4-2011.---The Sindh Public Private Partnership (Amendment) Bill, 2011,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 25th February, 2011 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 2nd April, 2011 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.--Whereas it
is expedient to
amend the Sindh Public
Private Partnership Act, 2010, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the Sindh Public Private Partnership (Amendment)
Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
